purpose: Measure one exact owner-search functionality and paid representation/admission placement against matched deterministic remote execution and permitted cache policies. No new generic optimizer, randomized-control defeat or secure-deployment claim.

implementation_stage.existing_420_runtime_sources_66_company_: Preserve exact registration-baseline.json pins; all new work is additive
implementation_stage.private_operations: Only the owner/client process retains HE keys. Spawned public producer/protected-verifier prototype workers receive public owner inputs and no HE secret. Public admission, at-most-once journal claim and a context-bound signed receipt must precede private finish.
implementation_stage.transport: Bounded length-framed actual loopback TCP. Explicit userspace pacing is experimental link shaping, not a measured AWS link or secure transport. Preserve per-link send/receive intervals, complete message lengths and digests.
implementation_stage.receipt: Protected worker signs only from the existing journal's admitted-and-claimed full-frame callback. Owner-provisioned local verifier anchor, exact request/snapshot/policy/nonce/ordered IDs, complete frame and current descriptor are checked before claiming a private callback. A local process/key/source digest supplies no attestation.
implementation_stage.unit_frame_scope: Only public grammar/state/transport fixtures; no invented HE-validity assertion or ciphertext-to-plaintext proof
cohort_preconditions: Complete additive worker/coordinator implementation; no missing execution mode is silently replaced with a measured stage model
All public transport/receipt/control tests pass within the cap; retain failures, corrected sources and every invocation

Freeze/hash exact runner, executed sources/libraries/dependencies, complete event DAG, initial states, warmup placement, arrivals, budgets and artifact retention before any fresh HE key or measurement
Pin and commit execution addendum resolving the exact arrival/warmup/setup semantics; this implementation registration alone does not authorize running an underspecified cohort
Validate the existing owner-origin profile, both actual primes, public support guards and sampler/key basis; preserve the unresolved parameter/private/deployment assumptions

functionality.owner: Honest owner querying its own data; may retain any plaintext
functionality.corpus: One public deterministic binary corpus, retained Q76.3b row bytes. Declare correlation; two new keys do not create independent corpora.
functionality.queries: Eight fixed binary words per block: the two retained source queries followed by six SHAKE256-derived words from domain cuhepy/Q77/public-query/v1 and indices 2..7. Identical plaintext queries and ordered-ID tie rule across every mode/policy.
functionality.ids: UInt64 maximum minus original row ordinal; rank (distance, ordinal), then map to bound ID
functionality.update: Exactly 32 ordinals 0..31 become alternating retained query0/query1 xor one, preserving shape/IDs; logical revision advances once. HE owner freshly re-encrypts all 512 feature packets in the affected group and re-signs full immutable enrollment, reuses unaffected group and evaluation keys. Native preparation is genuinely refreshed. Cache sends its canonical authenticated 32-row patch; never force it to download the HE index.
functionality.full_result: All exact distances plus original-ordinal top3; independently compare complete owner plaintext distances outside timed private finish
functionality.private_finish: Complete compact-P grammar and every physical plaintext lane; validate zero plaintext tails and score range/parity, select ordinal top3. Variable-time owner Python/GMP remains a local diagnostic implementation pending Q78.

modes.method: Existing full native producer plus complete public common-Q/both-actual-prime admission and terminal frame equality
Existing PreparedReplayAuthorizer computes once in protected prototype; no unnecessary producer witness
Existing aggregate producer plus all protected products and full suffix; negative control, not claimed arithmetic saving

policies: actual background acquisition while using frozen compatible remote policy
modes.method: Existing authenticated cache/native popcount; actual overlap, duplicate work and update invalidation must be measured

authority_boundary.local: Trusted owner/client and protected-worker runtime, fixed local verifier provisioning and local durable journals. Producer/store may be treated as adversarial by protocol tests. No host rollback resistance or attestation is enforced here.
authority_boundary.randomized_vFHE_adapter: Unimplemented; numeric comparison limited to implemented deterministic modes

hardware_and_links.host: Observed AMD Ryzen 7 5800X, 8 physical cores/16 logical CPUs, approximately 32 GiB RAM; verify again in execution freeze
hardware_and_links.role_affinity: Use different physical cores; record sibling activity. Never terminate unrelated user programs or change global governor/swap settings.
hardware_and_links.basis: Declared controlled prototype link conditions, not evidence of AWS performance; full duplex directions accounted separately
hardware_and_links.memory: Measure per-role/process owned components, RSS/PSS high-water/sampled peaks and overlap. No invented client memory limit or cache prohibition. Freeze conservative aggregate guard from the measured host's available memory before execution.
hardware_and_links.artifacts: At most 8 GiB additional cohort artifacts; retain public input/enrollment/patch/query bytes and all result/packet digests. Retain selected full witnesses, deterministic reconstruction inputs and every failure; do not duplicate every 127 MB witness or serialize any HE/AES/signing secret.
hardware_and_links.setup: Separate owner tenant crypto, public upload, fresh-process preparation, device metadata/cache acquisition and returning state. A new physical device's secure private provisioning is not measured by local retained-key custody.

cohort_caps.query_count_scope: Cache policies are repeated trajectories of one cache implementation, not independent cryptosystems. Candidate/known-composition and selector aliases are not extra experiments.

evaluation.split: First fresh process block per key/size calibrates; freeze and hash cost data, legal choices, policies and generic-selector implementation before the remaining two blocks per key/size
evaluation.primary: Mean client-visible completion minus declared arrival through current authenticated full distances and ordinal top3 over the frozen causal device/update trace. Exact setup/arrival/warmup initial state is an execution-addendum prerequisite, not deferred tuning after timing.
evaluation.weights: Uniform over the six key/size scenarios and eight measured queries; do not change weights in response to timings
evaluation.horizon: 1/8/128 device-lifetime accounting derived from the same paid stages is explicitly a model, not 128 measured queries
evaluation.policies: Compare each whole deterministic remote path, allowed returning/acquired/prefetched cache, evaluator-only selector and complete-cost selector. Give the generic exact selector identical observations/choices and include selection/repreparation overhead. Retrospective per-instance minima are oracle lower bounds.
evaluation.gate: 20 percent over best compatible frozen remote policy is only a project threshold. Cache utility and prior-separated originality are separate gates; agreement with generic selection does not establish new optimization.
evaluation.telemetry: Record monotonic clocks, CPU work, every link, startup/update stages, role memory, load, clocks/thermals, swap-in/out and per-process activity at <=1 second intervals; preserve failures/timeouts/contaminated runs without cherry-picking
evaluation.timeout: Freeze per-task and per-block deadlines before execution; no retry under a new key or replacement process after a consumed block without revised registration
evaluation.pairing: Rotate/reverse implementation order deterministically over key/size/block; preserve identical input and initial-state pairing
evaluation.numerical_scope: Local CPU prototype and explicitly shaped loopback paths only; no secure remote-service speedup, parameter approval, broad hardware generalization or author-artifact defeat
evaluation.stop: Return failures or dominance to the ledger. No new placement, changed sampler/noise law, extra key, workload retuning or new branch outside the frozen cap.

acceptance: Each role receives only its intended public or trusted-local inputs; every transport frame is bounded before allocation/parse
Malformed/foreign/stale/replayed/mismatched receipt and frame cannot reach a private callback; consume before callback and never invoke it twice
Producer modes, protected replay and cache return every exact independently checked distance, correct tails and ordinal ties after initial preparation and 32-row refresh
Full common-Q and exact aggregate actually execute complete runtime predicates; certificates and result signatures never replace runtime equality
Measured completion is a whole observed path, not a sum of stage medians; prefetch overlap and duplicate work are observed
Registration, implementation/execution freezes, calibration-policy freeze, every raw block and qualifications are retained; earlier evidence and source/library pins remain unchanged
Return pass/stop with exact counts to Q77 ledger; select Q78 deployment only if the useful system result survives; Q79 originality/paper remains required
